To drive a vehicle requires certain conditions relating to the physical and mental aptitude of the driver to be initially satisfied and thereafter maintained. It is therefore necessary to go to a designated medical centre for drivers who will verify whether there is a serious impediment to the applicant or driver, which will prevent them performing this task safely.
A mild illness does not have to exclude driving, although it can reduce the ability to drive safely (for example, a common cold can cause sleepiness and loss of concentration). questions.question:
El sistema avanzado de mantenimiento de carril (LKA), ¿qué función tiene?
What does the lane keep assist system (LKA) do?
questions.help:
DRIVING ASSIST SYSTEMS  
   
15 Lane Keep Assist (LKA)
The system controls the direction of the vehicle to keep it inside the lane, preventing it from drifting outside the lane if the driver is distracted or drowsy. Together with the LDW system, it monitors the vehicle’s position with respect to the lines delimiting the lane along which it is travelling. If the vehicle leaves, or is about to leave, the lane and the indicators have not been activated, it gently steers the vehicle back to the correct position.
(Página 93 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.question:
¿Qué sistema avanzado de asistencia a la conducción (ADAS) evalúa el estado de alerta del conductor y le avisa en caso necesario?
Which advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) assesses the driver's alertness and warns the driver if necessary?
questions.help:
FACTORS THAT AFFECT PHYSICAL CAPABILITIES  
   
13 Driver Distraction and Drowsiness Recognition (DDR)
The system assesses the driver’s level of attention in situations where he/she may lose concentration at the wheel, because of fatigue, sleepiness or other reasons.
The system monitors several aspects of the driver’s face, including how open his/her eyes are. It also analyses driving patterns and the driver’s reactions, combining them with driving speed data, the time and the use of indicators. If it detects that the driver is tired, it warns him/her by an acoustic or visual alert (displaying a coffee cup on the dashboard) or by making the steering wheel or seat vibrate, indicating the need for a break.
(Página 40 del manual 'Learning to drive')
